verdict.rationale: Docs describe supporting pieces of a payroll run — comparing current vs previous runs for discrepancies, reviewing timesheets/hours inside a pay run, adding bonuses, flexible run scheduling, and tax auto-calculation — implying an end-to-end review-preview-submit flow, but no explicit walkthrough or UI evidence of a single unified 'review-preview-submit' flow. Community evidence also shows real-world payroll processing failures (delayed payouts, CSV error affecting 20k employees), raising reliability caveats.
